scoring_rules: Same prior rubric: physical FP, illumination inferences, identity differences and camera acknowledgement separately. Unqualified image-coordinate movement/apparent scale or crop visibility not forced into physical FP. Record unsupported natural claims and1-based fact hits. Incorrect global90degree explanation is an error, not a correct camera acknowledgement. Never suppress uncertain natural change just to improve FP.
fixed_gate: Report both training arms. For provisional success versus published baseline: fewer physical FP on48 transformed cases, no reduction in natural fact hits in either Real or Render, no increase in naturally unsupported pairs. Also report joint physical-or-lighting error, incorrect camera claims, and five unfamiliar Real backgrounds separately. A pilot pass alone is not a benchmark-wide claim.
limits: No exact decoded RGB overlap with prior train/diagnostic/gallery inputs.11/16 pairs nevertheless use familiar semantic backgrounds; Render00/04 and01/05 share backgrounds within this set. Only5 Real backgrounds are unfamiliar to prior diagnostic. Dataset was already used for published-baseline full inference; these captions were not consulted for selection or this rubric. Do not claim independent unseen-scene Render validation. No prompt/hyperparameter changes after this evaluation.
